# YAMNet model

`yamnet.tflite` is the float32 YAMNet audio-classification model distributed by
Google MediaPipe. It is used locally to produce metadata-independent semantic
audio vectors. Source:

https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/audio_classifier/yamnet/float32/1/yamnet.tflite
